summary: A description of the choices BBN made when implementing the host-host protocol, the initial connection protocol and Telnet on the Terminal IMP. The machine had very little memory and had to drive many different terminals, so some protocol options were chosen to save space and some behaviors do not fully comply with the specifications.

eli5.summary: A tiny computer had to do a big job with very little memory. This note lists the shortcuts its builders took and the rules it does not follow exactly.
